capabilities: Browse commit graph and file history
extras: Desktop only; uses Node.js filesystem access and runs the installed Git with shell disabled. Git hooks and credential helpers follow local Git configuration. Note table rendering is optional and off by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Git interface, so users must leave the app to stage, commit, review changes, and resolve conflicts.

relations.evidence: requires Git and a vault initialized as a Git repository
add crli-idea/VaultBranch in BRAT, then enable VaultBranch

summary: Git source control panel for Obsidian that stages, commits, pulls, pushes, shows diffs and commit history, and resolves conflicts.
